seo.title: About Hukill's Inc. | Est. 1979
seo.description: Family-owned since 1979, Hukill's is built on faith, integrity, and craftsmanship. Learn about our mission, values, and the team behind the work.

hero.title: Family
hero.description: For more than 40 years, Hukill's has been delivering trusted plumbing, restoration, excavation, remodeling, and foundation services. Built on faith, integrity, and hard work, we remain committed to providing honest solutions, quality workmanship, and exceptional service for every customer we serve.
hero.imageAlt: The Hukill's crew on a job site at golden hour

mission.heading: Diligence, Integrity,
mission.body: Our mission is to create an environment where every individual has the opportunity to succeed through diligence, integrity, and faith. By putting Jesus Christ first, we trust that success and prosperity will follow.
mission.imageAlt: Craftsman's hands working on copper pipe

points.heading: Execution
points.body: High-quality services and products. Strong relationships. Leading by example.

points.heading: Success
points.body: True success is found in a life dedicated to faith, hard work, and unwavering principles.

items.title: Excellence
items.description: We pursue the highest standards in all of our work. We believe excellence is a habit, not a destination.

items.title: Integrity
items.description: We act with honesty and fairness in everything we do, ensuring our actions align with our words. We uphold the highest ethical standards and foster an environment of trust and respect.

items.title: Teamwork
items.description: We understand that success is built on collaboration. We value the unique strengths everyone brings to the table.

items.title: Servant-Hearted
items.description: We lead by serving. We aim to ensure our work not only brings prosperity but also blesses the customers we serve.

vision.heading: Measured by
vision.body: Our vision is to build a company where success isn't measured only by achievements, but by the impact we have on others. We strive to be a reflection of Jesus Christ in all that we do — so that everyone we encounter, employees, customers, and partners alike, can witness His love and transforming power.
vision.bulletsLeadIn: Through faith, integrity, excellence, and hard work, we will:
bullets: Glorify God in every aspect of our business

accountability.heading: We Hold Each Other to a Higher Standard.
accountability.body: As a company, we commit to holding one another accountable to these principles. If we, individually or as a team, fall short of these values, we will encourage and correct each other with honesty, grace, and humility. Together, we will strive to stay true to our faith, integrity, and mission — ensuring that our actions always reflect the love of Jesus Christ.
